pick.headline: Vietnam completes its withdrawal from Cambodia
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of September 26, 1989, carried East Berlin ADN on the GDR Foreign Ministry spokesman welcoming the complete withdrawal of Vietnamese "volunteer units" from Cambodia as a step toward a political solution, stressing prevention of a Pol Pot return.
